package rulefixtures

import (
	"database/sql"
	"net/http"

	_ "github.com/lib/pq"
	gorm "gorm.io/gorm"
	"gorm.io/driver/postgres"
)

// scenario for router_constructor_builds_concrete_dependencies: Router setup that creates DB clients, external clients, or repositories directly instead of receiving prebuilt dependencies.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.

func NewRouter() http.Handler {
	db, err := gorm.Open(postgres.Open("host=localhost dbname=app sslmode=disable"), &gorm.Config{})
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	sqlDB, _ := db.DB()
	sqlDB.SetMaxOpenConns(25)

	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	mux.HandleFunc("/api/health", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
	})
	return mux
}
